All 30 tests pass. Three bugs fixed:

1. `inventory.py:89` — `release()` returned inside the loop, freeing only the first reservation; removed the early `return`.
2. `pricing.py:90` — bulk discount used `quantity > 10` instead of `>= 10` (docs say "quantity >= 10").
3. `csv_io.py:59` — optional CSV columns only defaulted when missing, not when empty; now `if not row.get(col)` treats blank cells as defaults.
